brief.summary_1line: Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana spend their first night of exile by the Tamasa and secretly depart at dawn to spare the loyal citizens following them.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana rest on a bed of tender leaves beside the quiet Tamasa River under the dark forest night.
Lakshmana sits awake through the night beside the chariot, speaking with Sumantra while Rama and Sita sleep nearby.
At dawn Rama looks upon the sleeping citizens lying under trees and decides to depart silently across the river.
